verdict.rationale: Trilegal runs a public Knowledge Repository of short Updates, in-depth Analysis pieces and 'Unlocked' videos that 'break down complex legal concepts', searchable by practice area and year. It includes at least one equity-adjacent item (ESOP-buyback tax analysis). But nothing shows a startup-oriented knowledge base or founder-facing guides and FAQs on company formation or financing; it reads as a general legal-updates feed. Missing for 10: dedicated startup/founder guides or FAQs, plain-language explainers on formation and fundraising, evidence of equity/cap-table guidance beyond a single ESOP analysis.
